app.title: Hopladay
app.tagline: Plan your time off like a pro
app.welcomeDescription: Start by filling in your details to generate your personal vacation plan.
app.alreadyCreated: Already created one on another device?
app.productDescription: Hopladay is a vacation planner that combines public holidays, weekends, and your available days off to generate optimal vacation plans. The tool automatically finds the best combinations so you can turn a few vacation days into long breaks.
app.productFeature1: Automatically combines national holidays, weekends, and vacation days
app.productFeature2: Maximizes your time off by finding optimal date combinations
app.productFeature3: Supports multiple countries including Norway, Sweden, Denmark, and other European countries
app.productFeature4: Works as a vacation days calculator to help you plan efficiently
app.howItWorksDescription: Hopladay uses an algorithm to analyze your available vacation days, national holidays, and weekends to create the most efficient vacation plan possible.
app.step1Description: Select the country where you work and the year you want to plan for. Hopladay automatically loads all public holidays for that country.
app.step2Description: Tell Hopladay how many vacation days you have available for the year.
app.step3Description: The algorithm analyzes holidays, weekends, and your vacation days to find the best combinations that maximize your time off.
app.step4Description: Review the suggested vacation plan and make manual adjustments if needed. You can export your plan to calendar apps.
app.whoIsItForDescription: Hopladay is designed for anyone who wants to make the most of their vacation days and public holidays.
app.useCase1: People who want to maximize vacation days by combining them with public holidays and weekends
app.useCase2: Employees planning holidays around national holidays in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, and other European countries
app.useCase3: Anyone looking for a vacation days calculator to optimize their time off
app.useCase4: People who want to turn 3 vacation days into 7-10 days off using strategic planning
app.faq1Question: How does Hopladay maximize my vacation days?
app.faq1Answer: Hopladay maximizes vacation days by automatically finding combinations of public holidays, weekends, and your available vacation days. For example, if a public holiday falls on a Thursday, Hopladay will suggest taking Friday off to create a 4-day weekend. This often allows you to turn 3 vacation days into 7-10 days off.
app.faq2Question: Can I use Hopladay for Norwegian public holidays?
app.faq2Answer: Yes, Hopladay fully supports Norwegian public holidays. The tool automatically includes all national holidays in Norway, including Constitution Day (May 17th), Christmas, Easter, and other public holidays. You can plan your vacation around these holidays to maximize your time off.
app.faq3Question: Does Hopladay work for other countries in Europe?
app.faq3Answer: Yes, Hopladay supports multiple European countries including Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Netherlands, Germany, Belgium, France, Spain, Portugal, Italy, Switzerland, Austria, Ireland, and the United Kingdom. The tool automatically adapts to each country's national holidays and calendar.
app.faq4Question: Do I need an account to use Hopladay?
app.faq4Answer: No, you can generate vacation plans for free without creating an account. However, creating a free account allows you to save your plans, access them from any device, and sync them across multiple devices. Premium features like export and advanced strategies require an account.
app.faq5Answer: Yes, Hopladay is free to use for generating vacation plans. You can create unlimited plans and use the basic planning features at no cost. Premium features such as calendar export (ICS files), PDF reports, advanced planning strategies, and unlimited suggestions are available for a one-time payment of $5.
app.faq6Question: How do I combine public holidays with weekends?
app.faq6Answer: Hopladay automatically identifies when public holidays fall near weekends and suggests taking adjacent vacation days to create longer breaks. For example, if a holiday is on a Friday, taking Thursday off creates a 4-day weekend. The tool calculates these combinations automatically to maximize your time off.
app.faq7Question: How to maximize vacation days in Norway?
app.faq7Answer: To maximize vacation days in Norway, use Hopladay to combine Norwegian public holidays with weekends and your available vacation days. The tool automatically finds optimal combinations, such as taking a day off before or after a public holiday that falls near a weekend, turning 3 vacation days into 7-10 days off.
app.faq8Answer: Hopladay offers a 365-day money-back guarantee with no questions asked. If you purchase Premium and are not satisfied for any reason, you can request a full refund within 365 days of your purchase. Simply contact us at hello@hopladay.com with your account email address, and we'll process a full refund to your original payment method within 5-7 business days.

optimizer.errorCapacity: This combination of constraints is too complex to calculate. Shorten the planning period or relax the maximum number of breaks, then calculate again.
optimizer.unusedBalanced: The balanced strategy may keep leave unused to favor spaced breaks. Choose maximum time off to prioritize total days off.
optimizer.unusedInfeasible: The current constraints cannot all be met. Adjust them and calculate again.
optimizer.unusedConstraints: No more leave can be used within this optimal plan and its constraints. Review excluded dates, working days and break limits.
optimizer.maximumDefaultsHelp: For maximum time off, leave maximum length, number of breaks and separation blank to use the full-year defaults.
optimizer.advancedHelp: Weekdays: 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday, …, 6 = Saturday. Months: 1–12. Summer length 0 disables the requirement.
optimizer.analyticsConsent: Help improve Hopladay with anonymous action counts. No vacation dates, allowance or identity are sent. Optional and off by default.
optimizer.calendarHelp: Select a break to highlight its dates. Use arrow keys to move between dates; Enter selects a day.
optimizer.dateHelp: Enter local dates as YYYY-MM-DD, separated by commas. Excluded dates block entire breaks; approved leave does not use your new allowance.
optimizer.empty: No qualifying break fits these settings. Adjust the allowance or constraints and try again.
optimizer.errorAuth: Your session has expired. Sign in again to save plans or use Premium.
optimizer.errorGeneric: The request could not be completed. Check your connection and try again.
optimizer.errorInput: Check the dates, allowance and constraints. All dates must be valid and inside the selected year.
optimizer.errorPremium: This strategy or setting requires Premium. Sign in to your Premium account or choose Balanced.
optimizer.errorRate: Too many requests. Wait a minute before trying again.
optimizer.errorUnavailable: Holiday data is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
optimizer.exportHelp: Calendar events are not leave requests to your employer. Exports are all-day events without timezone conversion.
optimizer.infeasible: These requirements cannot all be satisfied. No invalid plan has been created. Adjust the locked breaks, budget or summer requirement.
optimizer.intro: Plan useful breaks around public holidays, weekends and the leave you already have. Start with three details; no account is needed.
optimizer.limitApproved: Already approved leave is fixed and is not deducted from the new allowance.
optimizer.limitBreaks: Breaks stay within the chosen year, cannot overlap or touch, and never include excluded dates.
optimizer.limitJurisdiction: Only holidays for the selected country and region apply. Confirm entitlement with your employer.
optimizer.metricsHelp: New leave days are charged to your allowance. Calendar days count only the distinct days inside suggested breaks, including weekends and holidays.
optimizer.objectiveHelp: The optimizer solves the selected, explicitly defined objective exactly within its declared limits. Balanced uses a defined utility score, not a universal measure of vacation quality.
optimizer.premiumExplanation: Premium adds alternative objectives, custom workweeks, company holidays, preferred months and summer requirements. Basic planning and editing stay free.
optimizer.reason_balanced: Balances useful break lengths, seasonal utility and your preferred months while respecting separation constraints.
optimizer.reason_longest_vacation: Selects the longest feasible continuous vacation, then maximizes useful remaining time off.
optimizer.reason_maximum_time_off: Maximizes distinct calendar days in qualifying breaks under your allowance and constraints.
optimizer.saveBeforeExport: Save this plan before exporting its calendar events.
optimizer.saveExplanation: Sign in when you are ready to save this plan across devices. Previewing and editing need no account.
optimizer.saved: Plan saved with the current holiday data.
optimizer.shareBasic: Share these basic settings (no private dates)
optimizer.title: Get the most out of your vacation days
optimizer.constraintsOk: All declared hard constraints are satisfied.
